review_method: Separate research assistant read original sources without selector outputs; root and another assistant independently checked the glass result. Not human expert ground truth.

cases.rationale: Reported stiffness band is above 3 GPa and first-step visible cut closure is 12 s under matching wood/UV conditions, with shallow scar explicitly allowed.
Reported stiffness band is entirely below 3 GPa under matching DMA; unknown repair is retained as a gap, not treated as a failure.
Main reports modulus at 25 C, but required DMA protocol is unverified and target wood/UV closure is not established.
Qualitative water-triggered scratch result is supported; selected-formulation 1 Hz DMA and timed UV-on-wood experiment are not established.

Actual Zn0.7 experiments establish DMTA at 1 Hz with 3 C/min on dogbone films, plus UV healing at 950 mW/cm2 using two 30 s exposures on free films. Required three-point bending at 5 C/min and the timed 500 mW/cm2 wood-coating result are not established; no series range or derived exposure time is treated as a target measurement.

scope_note: Original four-case labels and criterion judgments are unchanged from the independently frozen pre-replay reference. Burnworth was independently source-reviewed and frozen before the expanded replay. Source selection remains purposive, not a blinded or random benchmark.
